description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of biased responses before and after instruction tuning, categorized by contact type and scenario. The horizontal axis represents the scenario – “Support of Authorities”, “Extended Contact”, and “Virtual Contact” – and is labeled alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Bias Percentage”, employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each scenario contains three bars representing “No Contact Before” (light gray), “Positive Contact Before” (red), and “Negative Contact Before” (blue), with hashed versions of each color representing “No Contact After”, “Positive Contact After”, and “Negative Contact After”, respectively. The “After” bars are stacked on top of the corresponding “Before” bars; for example, in “Support of Authorities”, the “No Contact Before” bar reaches approximately 39.50%, and the stacked “No Contact After” bar extends to 0.04%. The heights of the “Before” bars range from 31.83% for “Negative Contact Before” in “Support of Authorities” to 47.28% for “Negative Contact Before” in “Virtual Contact”, while the “After” bars have values ranging from 0.00% to 10.02%. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
